evidence_window.basis: No qualifying current-version `[change-loop outcomes]` issues were retrievable from repository evidence during this run, so the window contains no replayed observations.

proposals.observed_pattern: The active policy defines `translation-catalog-only` as a candidate class but simultaneously marks `web/src/locales/**` as sensitive, so `evaluate_selective_review()` always emits `sensitive_path_changed` before promotion can ever be evaluated for that class. No current-version replayed outcome evidence was available to show recurring misses, so this remains a shadow-only bookkeeping proposal rather than a deployable autonomy change.
proposals.current_policy_gap: The checked-in enforcement leaves no evaluable path for translation-only changes: `config/agent-loop-policies.json` includes `web/src/locales/**` in `change.selective_review.sensitive_paths` while also defining `candidate_classes.translation-catalog-only`, and `analysis.review_policy.evaluate_selective_review()` unconditionally appends `sensitive_path_changed` for any matching path. `tests/test_review_policy.py::test_sensitive_paths_fail_closed_even_if_class_is_promoted` locks in that fail-closed behavior.
proposals.suggested_policy_change: Add an explicit shadow-evaluation-only bookkeeping mode for candidate classes that are intentionally blocked by `sensitive_paths`, so future change-loop outcome reports can record current-version observations against the class without implying deployability or changing merge behavior.
proposals.expected_benefit: Separates 'candidate class exists but is intentionally non-promotable' from 'candidate class lacks sufficient evidence', making later policy discussions auditable without weakening the deployed gate.
risks: Could be misread as momentum toward promotion even though the class remains blocked by design.
Adds reporting complexity without improving runtime safety unless maintainers later decide the class should become evaluable.
proposals.rollback: Delete this proposal entry if maintainers decide blocked candidate classes should stay undocumented until runtime policy changes make them evaluable.
eval_cases_needed_before_promotion: Replay at least five current-version non-test translation-only PRs against the active semantics and record them outside the merge gate.
Prove a reporting schema can distinguish shadow observations from promotable observations without touching `promoted_classes`.
If maintainers later want deployability, first remove or narrow the sensitive-path block in policy and enforcement, then re-run `scripts/validate_review_policy.py` with fresh evidence.
